definitions.bias: predicted final acceleration minus recorded next-row acceleration, m/s^2
definitions.classes: BASE row_classes: lane-1 HDV transitions; braking rec<-1; free road 5<v<20 and gap>60 or no leader; slow start unpartnered v<2 and 6<=gap<=30
definitions.ci: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap, 1000 draws; one-step clusters=windows, rollout clusters=snapshots with both seeds together; paired differences formed within state/seed before resampling; CI unavailable with <2 clusters or <5 finite rows. Rollout estimates are equal-run means (shares averaged per run), not pooled row ratios
definitions.rollout: 48 unique TRAIN snapshots x 2 seeds x 3 arms, 120 s, dt=0.5 s; t0 roster, entries off, recorded CAV teacher only, HDV recorded exits/junction overrides disabled; HDV lanes free
definitions.hard_braking: HDV transitions present at both ends with finite realized dv/0.5 < -3 m/s^2; denominator=finite HDV transitions (all lanes)
definitions.ttc: post-step HDV follower rows, nearest same-lane present leader (HDV or CAV); bumper gap/positive closing speed <1.5 s, including negative gaps; denominator=finite on-road HDV rows, including rows without a closing leader
definitions.overlap: post-step unordered same-lane present pairs with at least one HDV and negative bumper gap; ties ordered by slot; count=pair-steps, strict gap<0
definitions.blowup: run flagged if any post-step present HDV has nonfinite position/speed/lane, abs(position)>100000 m, speed<0 or speed>100 m/s, lane not in {0,1,2}, or any continuous HDV transition has abs(dv/0.5)>100 m/s^2; bad rows counted separately and never silently treated as safe
definitions.insertion: continuous-present HDV lane change into lane 0 or 1; excludes t0. Ramp merges are the subset lane 2->1; merges_per_run counts events, not vehicles
definitions.post_insertion: HDV inserter events only. Nearest vehicle strictly behind the inserter's front bumper in its new lane at insertion is the fixed follower (ties by slot). Count realized a<-3 on transitions ENDING 0.5..6 s strictly after insertion, only while the measured HDV is continuously present in the insertion lane. Both inserter-own and HDV-follower event-rows/shares are reported separately; overlapping event windows may count a transition more than once. Events without the full 6 s future are counted as truncated and excluded. Event-share denominator is full-window events with >=1 finite eligible transition; numerator any hard brake
definitions.stuck: clock starts at zero at t0; increments by 0.5 s for consecutive valid post-step HDV rows in lane 2, 0<=s<=75.44, speed<1 m/s; resets otherwise. Stuck means clock>60 s (strict). Report stuck vehicle-steps, final stuck vehicles, max clock and time-mean ramp occupancy in that zone (regardless of speed). Not a pre-t0 waiting-time estimate
definitions.delay: speed-deficit proxy veh-s = sum 0.5*max(0,1-v/31.29) over valid post-step HDV rows in all lanes with s<500. Regions: upstream s<0, merge 0<=s<75.44, downstream 75.44<=s<500. Report each region, total and exposure veh-s; invalid rows excluded and counted separately. This is not travel-time delay, and model exits end exposure
definitions.merge_zone: valid present post-step HDVs only, lanes 0 or 1, 0<=s<75.44 m; t0 excluded. merge_zone_mean_hdv_count is vehicle-rows divided by all post-step frames (empty frames count as zero). merge_zone_mean_speed_mps is the row-weighted mean speed over those HDV rows (null if empty); invalid rows and CAVs excluded
definitions.pairing: all three pairwise contrasts, later arm minus earlier; identical state/window and Python/numpy/torch/lane seeds; each snapshot has two distinct deterministic seeds
